plan.objective: 只在本地 CPU 上筛选有持续回读压力的原 Terminal-Bench 自然长会话，按已发布的双 APC 原生配置和相同工作量对比 100/200 Gbps 含排空总吞吐。用实测回读、P 交付和 D 供给解释差距并与 r28 比较。

scope: Selection uses only the two measured 200 Gbps references. Exact archived request bodies are identified by hashes. Every pair reuses reference native placements, observed cache/egress, natural EOS output, offers and dependencies. There is no traffic or arrival multiplier. The method replay uses real GET activity as a pacing constraint and exposes delay on each request's local P or on either P. It holds the 200 Gbps trace's group shape and does not predict changes in scheduling, placement or caching caused by a different bandwidth.
